description: Explain a quantakrypto finding and its post-quantum remediation. Provide a ruleId (e.g. 'forge-rsa-keygen', 'elliptic-ec', 'node-rsa', 'pem-ec-private-key') and/or an algorithm (e.g. 'RSA', 'ECDSA'). The ruleId is resolved against the core detector set, so library and config rules explain correctly.

algorithm.description: The classical algorithm family involved (e.g. RSA, ECDH, ECDSA).

ruleId.description: The finding's rule id, matching a detector id prefix.

name: explain_finding
